name: io.github.FerhatDundar/ghcli-mcp-connector
description: MCP server for the GitHub CLI (gh). Read-only by default; single Go binary.

environmentVariables.name: GH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: gh CLI token. Leave unset to use whatever `gh auth login` already configured (OS keychain).

environmentVariables.name: GH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Target a GitHub Enterprise hostname instead of github.com.

environmentVariables.name: GHCLI_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to permit state-changing gh commands. Defaults to read-only.

environmentVariables.name: GHCLI_MCP_ALLOWED_REPOS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of "owner/repo" values, enforced when -R/--repo is passed. Unset allows all.

environmentVariables.name: GHCLI_MCP_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the gh binary. Defaults to "gh" resolved via PATH.
